 What do we offer you? - Salary €15,- gross per hour - Full-time position. Departure from Deurne: typically between 06:00 - 07:00 - Travel time compensation - Company van provided - Stable, full-time work with consistent hours

Do you enjoy working with machines and are you accurate? At Zinkunie in Boxtel, you make metal products for roofs and facades. You work in 2 shifts, receive a 20% shift allowance and join a practical team where quality and teamwork are important. What are you going to do? 
As an operator, you work with different machines for beading, cutting and bending sheet metal. You set up the machines correctly, place the material in the machine and check the finished product. You work with work orders, drawings and clear work instructions. This job is therefore a good fit for someone who enjoys practical production work and does not mind doing the same tasks often. When needed, you may also use a forklift to move materials within the production area. 
 What are the working hours? 
You work in a 2-shift system: - From 06:00 - 14:00 - From 14:00 - 22:00

 - You are motivated and enjoy practical production work - You do not mind repetitive work - You work accurately and pay attention to quality - You are willing to work in 2 shifts - You speak English at minimum B2 level - Experience in production or working with machines is a plus
